objects.summary: Stage-B capture attempt 2 completes 35789/35789 archives with zero rows parsed, but controller stops before look on wrong plan hash copied from synthetic Stage-A test. Production acquisition hash is recovered from both real jobs; only reference is corrected under R7.

Single F1 Stage-B evaluation at theta=0.20 returns REJECT: mean/year -1.3569%, Sharpe -0.4485, robust t -0.8435, doubled-cost mean -2.9574%, final NAV 0.9622, 4/11 positive quarters and -5.3569pp vs assumed 4% cash. No retune or rerun; bytes/arithmetic authenticated independently.

F1 fixed expression is closed and continuation starts from REJECT, never reruns for failed comment publication. Next action is source qualification for public Binance COIN-M liquidation snapshots; archive existence is not treated as complete labels or valid event time.

Parallel literature review of nine primary technical-signal sources produces no local economic look or family activation. Trend+signed-volume reserved as research lead; correlated indicators are not counted as independent evidence. F1 REJECT/F2 blocked remain unchanged.

COIN-M source preflight recovers primary semantics: forceOrder is one latest order per symbol per 1000ms, Event Time differs from Order Trade Time, and official repo reports discontinued snapshot publication/duplicate rows. Four-file structural sample is frozen with header-only inspection; no economic field may be parsed before source qualification.

cross_object_findings.finding: F1 moves from underpowered positive discovery to a clearly negative sealed Stage-B result and is closed without retuning. This is real economic information, not engineering qualification.

A wrong plan hash copied from synthetic test output stopped Stage B before the look; actual acquisition-step provenance was recovered and only the reference was corrected, preserving data and statistical design.

COIN-M archive listings are treated only as data availability. Snapshot sampling, duplicate-row reports, event/trade time semantics and publication continuity must be qualified before any economic experiment.
External technical-indicator literature is retained as idea/source context but does not create a local look, reset prior negatives or establish tradable edge.
